acceptance.given: The evaluation-seed artifact contains the named seed records consumed by the toolchain validator.

oracle.expected: During unit validation, exactly three named evaluation seed occurrences are found, each recorded once with provenance, applicability, missing-label status, counterexample or explicit absence, and approved non-baseline classification.
forbidden: A named evaluation seed occurrence lacks provenance.
The named seed occurrences are not exactly three or are duplicated.
Any occurrence lacks applicability, missing-label status, counterexample or explicit absence, or approved non-baseline classification.
oracle.observable: The parsed validator result enumerates three unique seed records and exposes all required FR-6 metadata for every record.

acceptance.then: All three named evaluation seed occurrences have complete provenance and required FR-6 metadata.
acceptance.when: The toolchain validator parses evaluation-seeds.v1.json during the unit verification command.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Select the unit validator fixture that removes provenance from one named evaluation seed occurrence while preserving the other seed records and metadata.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Extend evaluation-seed validation so the three named occurrences are unique and each carries provenance, applicability, missing-label status, counterexample or explicit absence, and approved non-baseline classification.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Rollback restores the prior validator behavior; existing evaluation-seed records remain readable and non-authorizing.

slice_hint.state_transition: Seed validation transitions from checking seed families and native evidence only to requiring complete per-occurrence FR-6 provenance and classification metadata.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The unit validator reports three unique complete seed occurrences, and the provenance-removal selector produces a non-zero validation failure.
